captions.instagram:
The IRS just released the 2027 retirement numbers (IR-2026-136, November 12).

✔️ 401(k), 403(b), governmental 457 and TSP: $25,500 for 2027, up from $24,500.
✔️ Catch-up at 50 and over: $8,500, so most people 50+ can put in up to $34,000.
✔️ Ages 60 to 63: a higher catch-up of $11,750.
✔️ IRA limit stays $7,500, with a $1,100 catch-up at 50+.

If you want to max out in 2027, update your payroll election before your first January paycheck. Self-employed? A solo 401(k) generally has to be set up by December 31 for employee deferrals for this year.

Source: IRS news release IR-2026-136 and Notice 2026-66. General information, not advice for your situation.
